thread.title: Energy and Technology Sectors Fuel Triple-Digit Gain in Dow

author: MT Newswires
title: Energy and Technology Sectors Fuel Triple-Digit Gain in Dow
text:
Shutterstock photo Wall Street is building on Friday's rally, with the energy and technology sector fueling a 200-point gain in the Dow Jones Industrial Average. West Texas Intermediate crude oil futures ran up to a 3.5 year high as Saudi Arabia aims to drive a barrel of oil to $80, and President Donald Trump considers whether to end U.S. participation in the Iranian nuclear deal before Saturday. A second day higher in the Nasdaq has been amplified by a record high for Apple ( AAPL ) and strong price action in chipmakers.
